company.shortDescription: Stainless is a company that specializes in generating software development kits for APIs.
company.description: Generate best-in-class SDKs with Stainless. Developers expect your API to come with a typesafe client library in their language. With Stainless, you can deliver idiomatic SDKs while you stay focused on building the API.

productsAndServices.description: Generates Terraform providers from OpenAPI specs to enable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) management of API resources.
